ItemID: 1; Title: Joywayus Pressure Gauge 0 to 30 PSI Brass 1/4" Male NPT Thread Lower Mount, Multiple Function; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently have a pressure-testing project that needs this gauge.
ItemID: 2; Title: (4 Sets) 1/2"-13 x 6" Hex Bolt with Hex Nut, Flat Washers (SAE) and Lock Washers Hardware Assortement, Full Thread, Coarse Thread, 304 Stainless Steel 18-8; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These long bolts are too specific without a matching repair planned.
ItemID: 3; Title: Joywayus 3 Way (T-Port) Shut Off 1/2"G Thread Ball Valve with 3/4" Hose Barb Lever Handle Brass Fitting One Switch; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current hose-routing project requiring a three-way valve.
ItemID: 4; Title: Matework Step Drill Bit for Metal, Four Spiral Flute Cobalt Step Drill Bit (1/4"-3/4") Wear-Resistant TiAlN Coated, 1/4" Hex Shank Unibit for Carbon Steel, Stainless Steel, Wood, Plastic (M35 9 Size); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Enlarging holes in sheet metal would complement my rivet tools and existing drill bits.
ItemID: 5; Title: 3/8"-16 x 2-1/2" Stainless Steel Button Head Socket Cap Screws with Hex Locknuts and Flat Washers, 304 Stainless Steel, Full Thread, Coarse Thread, 6 Sets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my interest in assembly hardware, but I would check the required dimensions before choosing them.
ItemID: 6; Title: #8 x 5/8" Wafer Head Self Drilling Screws, 410 Stainless Steel, Mushroom Head Phillips Drive Self Tapping Screws, 100 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Short self-drilling screws look useful for fastening thin metal in my DIY projects.
ItemID: 7; Title: 1/4-20 x 3/4" (30 pcs) Truss Head Machine Screws, 304 Stainless Steel (18-8), Cross Recessed Truss Head Machine Screws, Phillips Drive, Coarse Thread UNC, ANSI B18.6.3T; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: This thread size matches part of my rivet-nut assortment and could be useful for removable assemblies.
ItemID: 8; Title: #6 x 1" Flat Head Self Drilling Screws, 410 Stainless Steel, Cross Recessed Countersunk Head Self Drilling Screws with Self Tapping Screw Thread, 100 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: They could suit flush fastening, but I would choose the shorter wafer-head screws for now.
ItemID: 9; Title: VIGRUE 310 Pcs #6 1/2'' to 1'' #8 1/2'' to 1-1/2'' Wood Screws Black Oxide Coated Stainless Steel Flat Head Phillips Drywall Screw Assortment Kit, Self Tapping Screws Kit in 8 Sizes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: I like having assorted fasteners available, but my existing wood-screw kit makes this less urgent.
ItemID: 10; Title: Joywayus Hex Nipple 1/4"NPT Male x 1/4"NPT Male Threaded Stainless Steel 304 Threaded Nipple Pipe Fittings for Brew Kit Home Piping (Pack of 5); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently assembling threaded piping or a brewing setup.
